steps.en: Foreign vehicles with unpaid offences are picked
steps.id: Kendaraan asing dengan denda belum lunas dipilih

steps.en: An XML file with vehicle numbers and offence details is built
steps.id: File XML berisi nomor kendaraan dan detail denda dibuat

steps.en: The file is sent to vHub every morning
steps.id: File dikirim ke vHub tiap pagi
steps.why_en: The job reports success once the file is staged, before delivery to vHub is confirmed.
steps.why_id: Job lapor sukses begitu file siap, sebelum pengiriman ke vHub terkonfirmasi.

steps.en: Each notice sent to vHub is recorded
steps.id: Tiap notice yang dikirim ke vHub dicatat

steps.en: vHub's reply for each notice updates its status
steps.id: Balasan vHub per notice memperbarui statusnya

steps.en: The vehicle list from vHub is received
steps.why_en: The list is only kept as a file and shown in the daily report; nothing else uses it.
steps.why_id: Daftar hanya disimpan sebagai file dan tampil di laporan harian; tidak dipakai proses lain.
